items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: Emma was one of those persons who, a woman in the man’s world who made her presence... That song was written about her.

ctx.x: Yes, “Sweet Emma.” It was, yeah, that’s another great tune and there’s a story behind it that’s great as well, because Emma was one of those persons who, a woman in the man’s world who made her presence, it was something else. And she not only is a great player but a dynamic personality. That song was written about her. You know? And so yeah, it had a strong sassy swing thing to it, and Nat [Adderley] did a great job.
He did. This may not seem like a big deal but you recorded “Everything Happens to Me.” And the whole first statement of the melody it’s just you and the drums. Am I correct?
